statement: DualSense valid_flag1 (common byte 1) gates the LED fields: bit 0 mic-mute LED, bit 2 lightbar colour, bit 3 release/reset LED state, bit 4 player indicators (bit 1 is power-save, used for hardware mic mute, not an LED). valid_flag2 (common byte 38) bit 1 gates lightbar_setup.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 159-170; SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 711-743 (0x01 microphone light, 0x04 LED colour, 0x08 reset LED state, 0x10 touchpad lights in ucEnableBits2). Linux calls bit 3 'release LEDs', SDL 'reset LED state'; no source defines the device's exact reaction to it.
